name: hbm_hc_q_static-hcq-r1-fc6e33e2b
purpose: First hardening of ot_hbm_hc_q_static (d4f slots hc_SW/SE/NW/NE, one R0 master): 432x432 exact, F20-programmed static HC quadrant LG client with one 1024x256 programme SRAM; regional reset relay (6 regions, port drives only ot_rst_relay); pins W lg_rr (LG pair leaves are W), N lg_wq/lg_rq, E x_wave/gathered (hc_eng), S result + F20 + status (density <= 5.5 pins/um per face).
